topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: When I heard the news that our apartment building was transitioning to condos, my first thought was relief—I could finally consider owning my space. But then I remembered our neighbors, the elderly couple who’ve lived here since the building opened. Would they be able to afford to stay? The single mom with a child just starting school—would she have to uproot her life? I’ve known about this possibility for a while, and I should have said something, done something, before it was this far along. Now, it’s too late. The plans are in motion, and the future of this place, and the people in it, hangs in the balance.
